**`dev → main` release PR — v0.50.0.** Bundles 71 commit(s) since v0.49.0.

**Built:** dispatched (coder ×3 / mechanic ×0)
**Coordinated in:** card#9026 (board 13) · rt#283

## Highlights

### New tools and commands

- `sprint-burndown` — a sprint is a config-declared set of lanes whose membership is a board query; one board read produces the HTML page, the `lanes.definitions` object the census consumes, and `--check` (#820).
- `coord-build` — the coder's mechanical envelope (format, lint, test, commit) as one command pair (#855).
- `coord-refuse` — a refusal marker keyed to the PR rather than to a head, so it binds at every head until a later `coord-approve` supersedes it (#849).
- `token-spend.py` — a seat can measure its own token spend on demand, with a record-dedup control; deliberately not a hook and not per-turn (#856).
- The kanban card ledger runs, is measured and reaches an install; `KanbanClient.fetch_board_status` is new and `fetch_board` is its fatal projection. Measured on Linux only — Windows is UNMEASURED (#653).
- `coord-thread-read` can say WHAT was posted: a verbatim `body` field on every `--json` row plus a `--body` text flag (#826).
- `changelog-tag-coverage.py --sync-guard` — nothing is lost from `[Unreleased]` across the post-release back-merge, and released sections are byte-compared against their tags (#843).
- `dl-traceability` ships as an adoptable BLOCKING CI template, with an ASCII-class doc-exemption boundary (#699).

### New guards and hooks

- `upstream-currency-check` — a read-only SessionStart hook reporting a seat's stale upstream artifact as BEHIND / STAGED-NEWER / PROCESS-STALE, each with a remedy. Opt-in (#621).
- A scratchpad-hygiene doctrine plus a janitor that removes working files of provably dead sessions. Opt-in (#618).
- `card-token-lint` refuses a parseable `card-<n>` below the board's card-id floor — the coordination-issue-number slip a well-formed token used to hide (#840).
- Every merge and approval wrapper warns before the merge when the bridge cannot corroborate a PR's card citation; advisory by default (`--strict-citation` off) (#831).
- `session-end-skip-lint` gains another token class: a block claim is satisfied only by a recorded live-check command, and a status post owes net queue movement (#674).
- A `§` pointer must land where the claim is OWNED — `[owns: <token>]` on the pointer, an `owns-` anchor on the owning paragraph, tagged on touch (#842).

### Changed behavior

- `coord-auto-merge` decides "is CI green?" from an ALLOW-list and refuses where it used to merge — see Upgrade warnings (#764).
- `coord-post` validates the protocol before it posts and refuses bodies it used to send — see Upgrade warnings (#852).
- `coord-task --body-file` derives the title's `to:` from the body's `TO:` line and refuses a disagreeing `--to`, or a body with no usable `TO:` (#830).
- `clear-decision.sh --boundary-check` returns rc 1 with a named UNVERIFIABLE / INCOMPLETE verdict where an unreadable path gave rc 0 and "working tree clean" (#803).
- `always-loaded-budget.py` withholds the demote prescription unless the recall gate reads `on`; verdicts, exit codes and byte figures are unchanged (#701).
- One board-stage reader in `coord.kanban_common` replaces the drifting copies — see Upgrade warnings for the install-order constraint (#836).
- PostToolUse and Stop hooks emit nothing on a pass; findings are unchanged (#851).
- The SessionStart digest carries a hard byte ceiling and moves detail behind pointers; nothing over the ceiling is deleted — `[coord-digest-truncated]` names bytes kept/total/ceiling and the command that prints the rest (#861).
- `handoff-check unpushed` classifies the branch population in one call, not one `git log` per branch; same output, same `excluded` semantics (#860).
- `dependabot-watch` reports per-alert branch state — LIVE-ON-`main` / FIXED-ON-`dev`, and UNMEASURED by name; declare no `branch_model.lines` and nothing changes (#853).
- Every `ci-verdict` carries `run_attempt`, so a re-run's green is recorded (#700), and the zero-runs clause beside a rollup verdict states what is true of the composition (#832).
- One SessionStart document per hook process, so a seat that just took a version bump still gets its stale-canon nudge (#818).
- `board-mover-check.py` recognises the bridge's reworded 403 and its sibling messages (#821).
- `session-state-load` says so when the memory index is unresolvable; the notice is three-state instead of silent (#828).
- Both inbox hooks interpolate one read+reply pointer primitive, with degraded-stub drift and the consumer floor guarded (#839).
- `memory-pack-lint` reads the role's seeding rule rather than a headcount of the directory (#817), splits the dead-pointer report by class and makes the prescribed `--fix` true (#835).
- `/coord:update` area 5's bucket glob excludes frontmatter-less files (#827); area 3 derives the wrapper set from `templates/bin/` and compares before copying (#819); a seat's hand-rolled `GH_TOKEN` profile line is migrated (#711).
- `coord-approval-gap` no longer reads a card token as a PR number, and the unfollowable `/coord:update` instructions it was filed with are corrected (#754).
- Git subprocess funnels scrub inherited `GIT_*` once per deploy island, so a hook in a linked worktree can no longer operate on the hook's repository instead of its target (#841); the kanban backlog-backup pair was the measured instance (#823).
- `bin-deployset-check.py` reads the area-3 roles cell through one parser (#845), and `coordination-inbox-check.sh` becomes deterministically observable under test (#837).
- The lane census places a dispatch that survived a `/clear`, and a staffed lane stops rendering WAIVED (#829).
- `shell-substitution-guard` gains Windows coverage for the registration-gating hook selftests that had none (#651).

### Docs, templates and orientation

- The review-severity rubric replaces its "everything else" residual with tags each defined by a test (#631).
- The `Built:` line gains a durable store, a write moment and a new value; the dispatching seat records the count at PR creation (#643).
- A parallel-dispatch doctrine for pm — derive the map, dispatch from the map (#647) — hoisted to `docs/parallel-dispatch.md`, which all three seats read (#648).
- Doc-retention parameters, the self-merge check set and the card-id provenance rule each move to one owner and the copies are deleted (#628, #834, #838); `pr-review-flow.md` owns the self-merge refusal set, with a derivation guard holding every restatement to the code (#675); the seat doc no longer promises that a title-or-branch token moves the card (#833).
- Canon #18 opens with the product-anchored mint gate and § Triage doctrine points at it (#848); canon #16 takes derivation-not-the-figure to every written surface (#850).
- Every shipped subagent def carries one turn-economy rule, owned once and drift-guarded (#854).
- The `§` citation recogniser now sees `§ **bold**`, and the memory-pack restatements that were pinned to nothing are pinned (#825).
- `terminal_columns` is documented in both of its spellings on every shipped example (#824).

### This repo's own CI

- Every push reaching `main` is recorded and classified as one labelled issue — before/after SHA, forced or not, the merged PR where there is one. It adds no branch protection and blocks nothing; merging this PR mints the first record, and `main-push:unexpected` is the label that wants a look (#822).
- A red-capable guard for stale engine-state and pointer claims about the vendoring subsystem, plus the `_vendor/_registry.py` claims it corrected (#627).
- 5 internal guard/selftest PRs; no shipped surface changes: #863, #857, #846, #844, #858.

## Upgrade warnings

- **`coord-auto-merge` refuses where it used to merge (#764).** A `stale`, null or unrecognised check conclusion, and an unreadable combined commit status, now stop the unattended merge; there is no escape hatch, and a refusal is a skip a human then merges. One pre-upgrade action: if your repo reports CI through legacy commit statuses, a `pending` status now refuses too — `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<a recent head>/status --jq '{state, total_count}'` answers whether that reaches you (`total_count: 0` ⇒ it does not).
- **`coord-post` refuses, pre-post, bodies it used to send (#852).** `create`, `comment`, `close --body-file` and `edit --body-file` exit 5 with the exact fix and post nothing; `--cross` roundtable posts are out of scope. Do two things first: install `coord_protocol.py` **beside** `coord-post` (`/coord:update` area 3 copies it — check the file is there; without it every team post exits 4, fail-closed), and if your coordination repo sets `protocol.queue_field_adopted_at`, spell it with an explicit offset (`"2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"`, not `"2026-11-01T00:00:00"`). `edit` now also reads `gh api repos/<coordination repo>/issues/<n>` and refuses if that read fails, so its credential needs issue-read there.
- **Refresh the installed `coord.kanban_common` package before the kanban tools run (#836).** `kanban-inbox-check.py`, `kanban-untriaged-check.py` and `kanban-writeback.py` import from it with no `except ImportError` and raise at load against a package predating this release — run `/coord:update` area 2 first. `kanban-backlog-backup` and `kanban-card-ledger` degrade to their stdlib-only sibling instead.
